contractLimits: Handles are storage-instance-local: identical index/generation from another instance is not rejected; integration must bind Mission to the correct State.
Acquire/release change occupancy and generation only; they do not reset or reconstruct engine entities.
Callbacks must supply proper alignment, lifetime, nonreentrancy and constructor semantics; Header fixtures are not game objects.

Generation saturation is source-reviewed, not tested through UINT64_MAX reuse cycles.

findings.description: Historical25-byte root stub used direct return jumps which Windows misrecognized as epilogues even with metadata: incorrect caller RIP/RSP/RBX at offsets13 and20. findings.fix: Register a dedicated RUNTIME_FUNCTION with UNWIND_INFO0100020000520030 for current41-byte stub. Keep table/code/helper alive until no executing readers or unwinds remain. Real Windows RtlVirtualUnwind recovered caller RIP,RSP,RBX at all41 byte PCs.

findings.description: Candidate calls an emulator resolver model, not a real Mission-associated storage backend. Signed range, occupancy/generation, current Mission association, stale native IDs and reader/job-barrier lifetime remain required. Storage handles alone do not supply those contracts.
